intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

h.gu: 4.1.1 Boiler ની વ્યાખ્યા અને Energy path

body.en:
A steam boiler is equipment in which water receives heat and steam is generated under specified conditions. A steam generator may include heating surfaces, water/steam spaces, combustion or another heat source, controls and safety fittings. Fuel energy passes through hot gases and metal surfaces to the water; a chimney is not the component that stores steam.

Applications include process heating and supplying steam to power equipment. A boiler is a pressure system, not simply a kettle enlarged without safeguards. This unit is assigned to practical hours in the syllabus; its listed weightage is 15%.
body.gu:
Steam boiler માં water ને heat આપીને specified condition પર steam બને છે. Heating surfaces, water/steam space, heat source, controls અને safety fittings તેની રચના મુજબ હોય છે. Fuel થી hot gases, પછી metal surface મારફતે water સુધી energy જાય છે.

Process heating અને power equipment માટે steam આપે છે. Boiler pressure system છે; safeguards વગરની મોટી kettle નથી. Syllabus મુજબ આ unit practical hours માં છે; weightage 15% છે.

body.en:
IBR means Indian Boiler Regulations. It provides a regulatory framework for applicable boiler design, materials, manufacture, inspection, testing and related safety matters. Legal coverage also depends on the governing legislation, current amendments and responsible authorities.

Learn why certified design, inspection records and authorised operation matter. Do not memorise an unverified size/pressure threshold as universally current. This lesson is not a compliance certificate or permission to install, pressure-test or operate a boiler.
body.gu:
IBR = Indian Boiler Regulations. લાગુ boiler માટે design, material, manufacture, inspection/testing અને safety નો regulatory framework આપે છે. Current law/amendments અને authority મુજબ applicability તપાસવી પડે.

Certified design, inspection records અને authorised operation શા માટે જરૂરી છે તે સમજો. Unverified pressure/size limit ને હંમેશાં લાગુ કાયદો ન માનો. આ notes compliance certificate અથવા boiler ચલાવવાની permission નથી.

body.en:
Classify by the fluid inside tubes: fire-tube boilers carry hot gases through tubes surrounded by water; water-tube boilers carry water/steam in tubes heated externally. Other axes include vertical/horizontal axis, internally/externally fired, natural/forced circulation, stationary/mobile and application/pressure class.

These axes overlap: a boiler can be horizontal, externally fired and water-tube simultaneously. Do not confuse boiler circulation with the chimney draught that moves combustion gases.
body.gu:
Tube ની અંદરનું fluid પ્રમાણે: Fire-tube માં hot gases tubes માં અને water બહાર; Water-tube માં water/steam tubes માં અને heat બહારથી. Vertical/horizontal, internally/externally fired, natural/forced circulation અને stationary/mobile બીજા axes છે.

એક boiler એકસાથે horizontal, externally fired અને water-tube હોઈ શકે. Water circulation અને combustion gases ચલાવતો draught જુદા ખ્યાલ છે.

body.en:
The traditional Cochran boiler is a vertical, multi-tubular, internally fired fire-tube boiler. Major parts include the vertical shell with a rounded upper steam space, furnace and grate in the lower region, combustion chamber, smoke/fire tubes, smoke box and chimney path. Water surrounds the heated furnace/tube surfaces.

A mountings diagram is functional, not an installation drawing; actual placement and protective requirements are manufacturer-specific.
body.gu:
Traditional Cochran boiler vertical, multi-tubular, internally fired fire-tube છે. Vertical shell, ઉપર steam space, નીચે furnace/grate, combustion chamber, fire tubes, smoke box અને chimney path હોય છે. Water heated furnace/tubes આસપાસ છે.

Diagram functional સમજ માટે છે, installation drawing નથી; fittings ની actual position manufacturer મુજબ છે.

body.en:
Fuel burns in the furnace; hot gases travel through the designed combustion chamber and fire tubes before reaching the smoke box/chimney. Heat crosses the metal to water around these surfaces. Heated water circulation and vapour separation produce steam collected in the steam space.

Its compact arrangement suits suitable smaller steam-demand applications in the teaching comparison. Capacity, pressure and suitability require actual specifications. The description does not prescribe firing, feedwater or valve settings.
body.gu:
Furnace માં fuel બળે; hot gases combustion chamber/fire tubes માંથી smoke box/chimney તરફ જાય. Metal મારફતે water ને heat મળે; circulation/vapour separation થી steam ઉપર steam space માં એકત્ર થાય.

Teaching comparison માં compact અને યોગ્ય નાના steam-demand માટે સમજાય છે. Actual capacity/pressure specifications પરથી નક્કી થાય. અહીં firing/feedwater/valve setting ની operating સૂચના નથી.

body.en:
The traditional Babcock and Wilcox boiler is an externally fired water-tube boiler with an upper steam/water drum, inclined tube bank, headers and connections for circulation, furnace, gas-guiding baffles and a flue path. Water is inside the tubes; hot gases move around them.

Inclined heated tubes and density differences support natural circulation in the conventional model. Headers connect tube ends and the drum circuit. Designs may include a superheater and other accessories; the textbook picture is not a universal modern arrangement.
body.gu:
Traditional Babcock and Wilcox externally fired water-tube boiler છે. Upper steam/water drum, inclined tubes, headers, circulation connections, furnace, baffles અને flue path હોય છે. Water tubes અંદર અને hot gases બહાર છે.

Conventional model માં inclined tubes અને density difference natural circulation માં મદદ કરે. Actual designs માં superheater/accessories અલગ હોઈ શકે; textbook picture universal નથી.

h.en: 4.2.4 Babcock and Wilcox — working and comparison
h.gu: 4.2.4 Babcock and Wilcox — કાર્ય અને સરખામણી

body.en:
Hot gases are guided across tube banks, transferring heat to water inside. Heated two-phase fluid rises through the circulation path; steam separates in the drum and denser water returns through the appropriate paths. Baffles improve gas contact with heating surfaces.

Compared with a basic fire-tube arrangement, a water-tube design can suit higher duties/pressures with an appropriate engineered system, but not every water-tube boiler is automatically superior for every job. Compare cost, water quality, maintenance, load and safety requirements.
body.gu:
Baffles hot gases ને tube banks પર guide કરે. Tube અંદર water heat લે; heated mixture circulation path માં ઉપર જાય, drum માં steam separate થાય અને dense water યોગ્ય path થી પાછું આવે.

Engineered water-tube design higher duty/pressure માટે યોગ્ય હોઈ શકે, પણ દરેક કામમાં આપોઆપ શ્રેષ્ઠ નહીં. Cost, water quality, maintenance, load અને safety સરખાવો.

body.en:
Mountings provide essential control, indication and protection functions. Safety valve: release excess pressure under its certified design; pressure gauge: indicate pressure; water-level indicator: show the specified water-level condition; steam stop valve: control/isolate the steam outlet as designed.

Feed check valve controls feed entry and opposes backflow; blowdown/blow-off arrangements remove specified water/sediment under an authorised programme. A fusible plug, where fitted, is a design-specific protective device and not a substitute for correct water-level protection.

The syllabus asks functions, not live operating procedures. Never adjust a safety-valve setting or test low-water behaviour experimentally.
body.gu:
Mountings control, indication અને protection આપે. Safety valve certified design મુજબ excessive pressure છોડે; pressure gauge pressure બતાવે; water-level indicator level condition બતાવે; steam stop valve designed outlet control/isolation કરે.

Feed check valve feed entry/backflow માટે; blowdown arrangement authorised programme મુજબ water/sediment removal માટે. Fusible plug જ્યાં fitted હોય ત્યાં design-specific protection છે; proper low-water protection નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

માત્ર functions શીખવાના છે; safety valve adjust અથવા low-water experiment ન કરવો.

body.en:
Accessories improve performance or meet a particular output duty. Economiser preheats feedwater using available flue-gas heat; air preheater heats combustion air; superheater raises steam temperature above saturation at its pressure; steam separator removes entrained liquid droplets; feed pump supplies water against the required pressure.

A superheater does not merely separate droplets mechanically, and an economiser is not the safety valve. In a given installation some items are essential to the whole system even though textbook classification calls them accessories.
body.gu:
Accessories performance/output duty સુધારે છે. Economiser flue-gas heat થી feedwater preheat કરે; air preheater combustion air ગરમ કરે; superheater steam નું T saturation કરતાં વધારે કરે; separator liquid droplets અલગ કરે; feed pump required pressure સામે water આપે.

Superheater ફક્ત mechanical droplet separator નથી; economiser safety valve નથી. Textbook accessory હોવા છતાં actual system માં item જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
On a safe teaching model or approved drawing, identify the gas path, water/steam path, tube type, furnace and drum/shell. Label mountings by function rather than guessing positions. Record only observations actually made.

Keep boilers, pressure tests, blowdown and firing under authorised trained personnel and applicable procedures. Do not open a live fitting or approach a steam leak. Revision: Cochran fire-tube; Babcock and Wilcox water-tube; mountings protect/control, accessories improve a duty.
body.gu:
Safe model/drawing પર gas path, water/steam path, tube type, furnace અને drum/shell ઓળખો. Mountings ને function થી label કરો; position guess ન કરો. Actual જોયું હોય તે જ report કરો.

Pressure test, blowdown/firing trained authorised staff માટે છે. Live fitting ખોલવું અથવા steam leak નજીક જવું નહીં. Revision: Cochran fire-tube; B&W water-tube; mountings control/protect, accessories duty સુધારે.
